Posting Detail Information

Position Summary
The Department
of Economics at the University at Buffalo seeks to
hire, at the level of Assistant Professor
(tenure-track), an economist specializing in industrial
organization, microeconomic theory, and/or macroeconomics.
Candidates should have research interests related to artificial
intelligence, broadly defined. This might include the effects of AI
adoption on firms and industries, the economic analysis of AI
algorithms, the design of public policy around AI use, or the
application of machine learning to data analysis. This position
requires a PhD in hand or firmly expected by August 2027.

Candidates are expected to be active researchers with the potential
to excel in publication and build a strong scholarly reputation in
economics. We especially welcome applications from advanced
assistant professors with a demonstrated track record of research
success. Responsibilities also include undergraduate and graduate
teaching and advising, and participating in service to the
department, university, and discipline.

Applications received by November 30, 2026 will receive priority
consideration. The position will remain open until filled.
